statusDefinitions.PASS: The latest retained actual application attempt passed its local predicates. Screenshot completeness is reported separately.
statusDefinitions.FAIL: The latest retained actual application attempt failed. The retained error limits the cause claim.
statusDefinitions.BLOCKED_NOT_EXECUTED: No completed actual attempt exists. Quality and screenshot limits are reported separately.
statusDefinitions.SKIPPED_BY_USER: The user excluded this prerequisite-dependent case from this audit. Prior attempts remain historical evidence.

stepEvidenceDefinitions.COMPLETE: Each exact canonical step executed and has at least one valid retained screenshot.
stepEvidenceDefinitions.INCOMPLETE: Canonical step metadata exists, but execution or screenshot evidence is incomplete.
stepEvidenceDefinitions.LEGACY_ESSENTIAL_FRAMES: Named screenshots exist without canonical step records. Step evidence not recorded.
stepEvidenceDefinitions.NOT_RECORDED: No actual application attempt has canonical step evidence.

limits: Synthetic checks never change canonical results.
Each attempt records its implementation, fixture boundaries, and source hashes. Local execution does not establish deployed business acceptance.
All attempts remain available. The latest completed actual attempt determines the local predicate status.
Canonical quality failures block acceptance independently of the local execution result.
Complete step screenshots do not establish complete canonical assertion coverage or business acceptance.

limitations: Automated checks do not check the complete approved dictionary or grammar rules.
